description: List the most recent deliveries to a webhook endpoint, newest first, with each attempt count and the receiver's last HTTP status code. Deliveries are kept for 30 days and payloads are never returned. Only the account owner's API keys and connected apps can read webhooks. Reading changes nothing.
name: list_webhook_deliveries

event_id.description: The webhook-id header the receiver saw.

last_status_code.description: The receiver's last HTTP status code, or null if it never answered.

status.description: pending: waiting to be sent or retried. delivered: the receiver answered with a 2xx status. failed: every attempt failed; a test event is tried once and never retried. dropped: removed before sending, for example after an address change.

title: List a webhook endpoint's deliveries
